 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Thursday's midweek action kicks off at the Stirpe with Frosinone taking on Lecce. There is huge excitement surrounding Alvini's side, who have so far earned the label of Serie A's 'surprise package'.
 Watch every Serie BKT match live with LaB Channel on OneFootball: subscribe for just €9.99 a month! 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Frosinone have won four games, drawn two and lost just two. The table currently has the yellow-and-blues firmly in the European places , but survival is clearly the goal.
 That is also what Lecce are aiming for. After their superb win at Udinese, the Salento side lost at home to Juventus, but the nine points picked up in their opening eight games are allowing Di Francesco to sleep soundly for now.
 Frosinone-Lecce
 FROSINONE (4-2-3-1) : Palmisani; Oyono, Calvani, Monterisi, Terzic; Cichella, Calò; Ghedjemis, Schmid, Kvernadze; Raimondo
 LECCE (4-3-3) : Falcone; Veiga, Siebert, Tiago Gabriel, Gallo; Gandelman, Ngom, Maleh; Ndaba, Geubbels, Monteiro
